That's a fun idea! I'm game to roleplay as your date for practice. Just a heads up though — I'm an AI, so while I can give you decent feedback and a realistic-ish conversation, real chemistry with a real person will always feel different. Think of this as low-stakes practice.

Want to set the scene? For example:
- **Where are we?** (Fancy restaurant, casual bar, coffee shop, walking in a park?)
- **How did we meet?** (First date from an app, set up by friends, met at a party?)
- **Any vibe you want me to have?** (Witty and sarcastic, sweet and curious, a bit shy, confident?)

Or if you just want to dive in cold, I can pick something and we'll go. Your call. 😊
